items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Probably Johnny Smith and I don’t know but… Well, Johnny was in New York, I guess.

ctx.x: The other guy. (laughs) And I remember we, the first place we went, like dummies, we went to the Musicians Union ‘cause they had a big rehearsal space there, and I was looking through the union book. There’s Andre Segovia, (laughs) I don’t know, all kinds of guys. Probably Johnny Smith and I don’t know but… Well, Johnny was in New York, I guess. And I said… it was a little bit frightening to see, you know, ‘cause I was still in my mid-twenties.
Did you have a plan, a goal… aside from the convenience and sort of the serendipity of having the ride, had it occurred to you maybe I should be going to New York but you went to L.A.?
